positioning.best_fit_customers: children, youth, and families in the San Francisco Bay Area needing specialized mental health services, especially those covered by Medi-Cal and government programs

strategy.how_to_win: By leveraging its long institutional history and strong government payer relationships to provide a comprehensive continuum of mental healthcare services including crisis stabilization, residential treatment, outpatient therapy, and family-focused kinship support, while emphasizing its nationally recognized kinship program and its role as a key provider in the Bay Area youth mental health ecosystem.
strategy.where_to_play: Youth and families in San Francisco and San Mateo counties, including children and youth served by multiple programs such as the Therapeutic Behavioral Services program for ages 3-21 with Medi-Cal/Medicare, and youth referred to crisis stabilization and outpatient services through partnerships with school districts and county agencies.
strategy.winning_aspiration: To provide expert, comprehensive mental healthcare and supportive services that transform the lives of youth and families facing mental health challenges, trauma, and crises in the San Francisco Bay Area.

must_have_capabilities.text: Strong government contract and payer relationship management to sustain funding and program delivery.
Integrated clinical and community-based service delivery across prevention, crisis care, residential, outpatient, and family support programs.
Specialized program expertise in kinship support and crisis stabilization for youth under 12.

promise.promise: Edgewood Center for Children and Families promises expert, trauma-informed mental healthcare and support services for youth and families in the San Francisco Bay Area, including 24-hour crisis stabilization, intensive residential care, outpatient programs, and a continuum of care designed to promote healing, safety, and long-term well-being.

items.label: 24-hour crisis stabilization
items.statement: Edgewood offers 24-hour crisis stabilization services to youth and families.

items.label: Intensive residential care
items.statement: Edgewood provides intensive residential care for youth with serious mental health needs.

items.label: Behavioral Health Outpatient Program
items.statement: The Behavioral Health Outpatient Program delivers comprehensive, community-based mental health services to children, adolescents, young adults, and their families throughout San Francisco.

items.label: Enhanced Care Management (ECM) Team
items.statement: The Edgewood Enhanced Care Management Team provides person-centered support to Medi-Cal recipients enrolled in the San Francisco Health Plan, serving youth up to age 21 and current or former foster youth up to age 25.

items.label: Therapeutic Behavioral Services (TBS) program
items.statement: Edgewood operates a Therapeutic Behavioral Services program serving ages 3-21 with Medi-Cal/Medicare.

items.label: Non-Public School (NPS) program
items.statement: Edgewood runs a Non-Public School program for youth with IEP referrals from partner school districts, serving grades 5-12 with a student-teacher ratio of 9:1.

items.label: Crisis Stabilization Unit (CSU)
items.statement: Edgewood operates a Crisis Stabilization Unit created in conjunction with San Francisco Department of Public Health, providing a safe, structured, child-friendly, and family supportive environment for youth under 12 and up to age 17.

items.label: Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
items.statement: Edgewood offers a Partial Hospitalization Program as part of its levels of care for youth and adolescents.

items.label: Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
items.statement: Edgewood provides an Intensive Outpatient Program relaunched in 2023, serving youth with behavioral health needs.

items.label: Kinship program
items.statement: Edgewood offers a nationally pioneering Kinship program with a 90%+ family-placement retention rate over three decades.

items.label: Drop-in Centers
items.statement: Edgewood operates Drop-in Centers in San Bruno and Redwood City serving youth ages 18-25.

items.label: Affiliated Residential Treatment and Mental Health Services
items.statement: Edgewood provides affiliated residential treatment and mental health services, with Kaiser Permanente listing Edgewood as a provider.
